_doc: Every shortcode and block this plugin registers, and who may see what it renders.
A privacy rule that lives only in a REST controller is a rule the page does not have.
The same order, service or profile is reachable through a shortcode, and RenderSurfaceAuthorityTest
dispatches the member-scoped ones as an anonymous caller and fails if they render anyway.
audience: public = renders for anyone, including signed out |
owner = requires the viewer to be a party to the object it renders |
A member/owner surface MUST carry a refusal string: the text it returns to someone who
may not see it, which the probe asserts on. Without that the probe can only check a byte
count, and a surface that renders an empty shell would pass.

wpss_account.reason: The member's own account area - orders, downloads, profile. Verified in source on 2026-09-23: StandaloneAccountProvider::render_account_shortcode() returns render_login_form() when ! is_user_logged_in(), so a signed-out caller is shown the log-in form and no member data.
wpss_account.conditional_on: The standalone rail - StandaloneAdapter::init() registers this shortcode; when a cart plugin owns checkout it supplies its own account page instead.

wpss_buyer_requests.reason: Public job board - a request exists to be found by vendors who are not signed in.

wpss_cart.reason: Renders the CALLER'S OWN cart, which for a signed-out visitor is the session cart. No other member's data is reachable.

wpss_checkout.reason: Checkout for the caller's own cart. Payment authority is enforced server-side at settle time, not by this surface.

wpss_dashboard.reason: The member's own dashboard. Verified signed out on 2026-09-21: returns the log-in notice, not a dashboard.

wpss_featured_services.reason: Public marketplace catalogue - renders the same published data the public REST routes serve.

wpss_login.reason: Login form - necessarily reachable signed out.

wpss_my_orders.reason: The member's own orders. Verified signed out: returns the log-in notice.

wpss_order_details.reason: One order, resolved from the request. Verified on 2026-09-21 against order 322: anonymous gets the log-in notice, an unrelated member gets 'You do not have permission to view this order', and only the buyer and the vendor render it. manage_options may also view.

wpss_post_request.reason: Posting a buyer request requires an account. Verified signed out: returns the log-in notice.

wpss_register.reason: Registration form. Honours users_can_register; see Basecamp 10321653411.

wpss_seller_card.reason: Public vendor card. Renders nothing without a resolvable vendor.

wpss_service_categories.reason: Public marketplace catalogue - renders the same published data the public REST routes serve.

wpss_service_search.reason: Public marketplace catalogue - renders the same published data the public REST routes serve.

wpss_service_wizard.reason: Service creation. Verified signed out: returns the log-in notice; vendor capability is checked inside.

wpss_services.reason: Public marketplace catalogue - renders the same published data the public REST routes serve.

wpss_top_vendors.reason: Public marketplace catalogue - renders the same published data the public REST routes serve.

wpss_vendor_profile.reason: Public vendor profile, the same data GET /vendors/{id} serves.

wpss_vendor_registration.reason: Become-a-vendor form. Reachable signed out so a visitor can see what is involved; the submission itself is gated.

wpss_vendors.reason: Public marketplace catalogue - renders the same published data the public REST routes serve.
